title: Quick-command list and run API over MCP
goal: A validated, configurable list of quick commands (label, MCP server, tool, fixed arguments) and an endpoint that runs one and returns the tool's surface-typed result or its MCP Apps page or link
acceptance: The list lives in NERV's settings with a schema: label, server, tool, arguments; unknown servers or tools are rejected when saved and shown as unavailable, never guessed

Running a command calls the owning project's MCP tool through NERV's MCP client and returns its result unchanged: a surface-typed payload, an MCP Apps page or a link; NERV builds no view of its own (coordinator docs/DOMAINS.md, "The rule for screens")
A test across the join: a fake MCP server returns a surface-typed result and the endpoint returns it; a failing or slow server gives a bounded error
privacy: Neutral invented commands, servers and results only; no tokens in configuration examples, tests or logs.
escalation: A new permission or a write tool in the list goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: a settings schema, one run endpoint on the existing MCP client and a fake-server test. Not a measurement.
